slice: D4 - kids, family, hobby, office and desk

ideas.name: Daylight-matched desk lamp shade/diffuser clip
ideas.concept: Clip-on CRI/CCT-tuned diffuser and glare hood for common LED desk lamps and monitor light bars.
ideas.target_customer: Home-office workers and students in SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesised recurring complaint: glare on screen and harsh cold light from cheap desk lamps (UNVERIFIED).
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: Firecrawl out of credits and WebSearch budget exhausted; no review pages seen.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Daylight/indoor-climate know-how from VELUX, own optical design registered as design right.
ideas.tooling_needed: Thin PC/PMMA diffuser cut or thermoformed; low tooling

ideas.name: Leak-proof kids bento insert system
ideas.concept: Silicone-sealed divider inserts that retrofit popular lunch boxes to stop leaks and sauce mixing.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesised complaint: lids leak despite 'leakproof' claims (UNVERIFIED).
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no review data could be retrieved this run.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design registration and fit-guide for specific lunch box models; food-contact LFGB silicone certification as barrier.

ideas.name: Non-slip, non-scratch laptop stand pads kit
ideas.concept: Retrofit pad and stabiliser set that fixes wobble and slip on thin aluminium laptop stands.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesised complaint: wobble, sliding and scratched laptops (UNVERIFIED).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; relies on brand and bundle with design-led stand. Likely copyable.

ideas.name: Reusable adhesive-free cable clip desk system
ideas.concept: Clamp-on (no sticky tape) cable channel for desk edges of varying thickness.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesised complaint: adhesive cable clips fall off over weeks (UNVERIFIED).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Mechanical design patent/design right on clamp geometry.
ideas.tooling_needed: Extruded profile or small aluminium die; avoid steel injection mould

ideas.name: Refillable whiteboard marker and eraser family kit
ideas.concept: Refillable-ink dry-erase markers with a felt-pad eraser, sold with ink refills for home planners and kids.
ideas.problem_solved: Hypothesised complaint: markers dry out fast, ghosting stains on boards (UNVERIFIED).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary low-ghosting ink formulation plus refill ecosystem (repeat purchase); REACH/EN71 compliance.
ideas.tooling_needed: Existing marker bodies with custom ink; low tooling
